reading_paths.question_zh: 哪些模型能力真正拉开差距？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 能力差异→总分信息损失→汇总规则→测量效度
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 先理解差异，再验证一种总分是否足以表达它。

reading_paths.question_zh: 信息不足如何影响模型的决策？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 信息条件→无依据补充→执行表现→提问频率
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 主动决策需要证据基础，提问频率只是表面行为。
reading_paths.question_en: How do information gaps change decisions?

reading_paths.question_zh: 为什么局部回答不等于交互成功？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 局部行为→逐轮分化→终局→任务目的→耐心机制
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 长期轨迹必须连同对话目的和结束条件一起解释。
reading_paths.question_en: Why can good replies lead to poor outcomes?

reading_paths.question_zh: 一个模型的成绩有多少属于它的伙伴？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 配对依赖→伙伴区分力→能力压力→角色差异→多人规模
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 能力的分析单位逐渐从个体扩展到配对与群体。
reading_paths.question_en: How much of a score belongs to the partner?

reading_paths.question_zh: 增加认知架构会改变哪些能力？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 阶段增益→能力类型→基座依赖→能力分野
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 架构增益不同于规模效应，并且要联系基础能力。

reading_paths.question_zh: 模型内部状态究竟可读、可区分还是可控制？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 角色读出→主体区分→误差→深层整合→干预
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 按表征证据层级递进，避免把可解码误当成真实理解。
reading_paths.question_en: Can internal states be read, separated and controlled?

reading_paths.question_zh: 为什么可以信任这套交互评估？
reading_paths.argument_zh: 重建消融→人审→提取器→评估器→汇总方式→成本
reading_paths.reader_takeaway_zh: 将评估器自身的有效性和可靠性也作为测量对象。

paper.note: Evidence links refer to the manuscript edition matching the supplied v5 taxonomy. The earlier site manuscript remains available separately.

status: taxonomy, site navigation and focus proposal; no live site changes
principle: Each finding has one primary research-question category. Related findings and next steps are navigational connections, not causal inferences.
title: InteractNet: 40 academically reviewed findings

categories.research_question_en: What distinguishes the capabilities of contemporary models?
categories.research_question_zh: 今天的模型，究竟在哪些交互能力上拉开差距？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 按被测能力来分组：执行、主动性、策略延续及其代理指标，而不是按某张表或某个具体模型分类。
categories.in_scope_zh: L1–L6 能力结构、相近执行与不同主动性、策略推进、提问行为与主动性区分
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 不收录综合评分公式（C07）、信息条件操作（C02）
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 已观察到的能力差异，在信息不足或场景改变时是否保持？

categories.research_question_en: When do information and objectives change model performance?
categories.research_question_zh: 在什么信息条件和交互目标下，模型行为会发生改变？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 把输入条件和目标条件放在一起：两者决定何种行动有证据、有价值；不把这些条件误说成模型固有能力。
categories.in_scope_zh: 任务与关系目标差异、信息充分性、无依据事实补充与证据约束
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 不收录用户反馈随时间累积的结果（C03）
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 即便某一轮回答看似合适，整段交互最终是否真的进展？

categories.research_question_en: How can locally adequate replies produce different long-run outcomes?
categories.research_question_zh: 为什么局部合理的回答不一定带来长期进展？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 按时间上的观察对象分类：状态如何变化、重复如何积累、何时结束，以及目标如何决定结束的解释。
categories.in_scope_zh: 局部与全局反差、逐轮差异、停止机制、终局与任务目的
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 不收录测量算法本身的有效性验证（C07）
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 一条交互轨迹的质量，究竟是谁贡献的——模型还是伙伴？

categories.research_question_en: To what extent does performance depend on who interacts, and how many?
categories.research_question_zh: 同一个模型，换对象、换角色或增加参与者后，表现会如何变化？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 统一以交互单元而不是单模型为分析对象：二人配对、角色、互相适配和多人规模是同一问题的不同层级。
categories.in_scope_zh: 配对效应、模拟用户区分力、自我配对、角色不对称、多人交互
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 架构作为外加干预的增益归 C05，不将“人数”当作“架构”
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 交互复杂性会放大差距；能否通过认知架构增强主动能力？

categories.research_question_en: Which capabilities change when a cognitive architecture is added?
categories.research_question_zh: 给模型加入认知架构后，哪些交互能力得到改善？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 按干预手段分类：所有结论都比较基础模型与增强架构，区分增益的幅度、能力方向和基础水平依赖。
categories.in_scope_zh: MetaMind、Cognizer、Claude Code 的阶段增益、任务偏向及基础模型依赖
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 不是多人规模问题（C04）；不是隐藏层表征实验（C06）
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 架构能改变外在行为；模型内部如何表示交互对象的信息？

categories.research_question_en: What is encoded, shared, integrated, and controllable inside the model?
categories.research_question_zh: 模型内部能否区分交互双方状态，又如何整合对方的信息？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 按证据层级归类模型内部结果：解码、角色依赖、跨模型一致性、层间恢复与行为干预；与外部表现分开。
categories.in_scope_zh: 用户投入程度读出、affection 状态区分、对齐与误差、深层整合、控制性干预
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 不把探针可读性等同于主观体验，也不把测量框架消融归入内部机制
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 内部读出具有局限，评估框架怎样避免把推断当成事实？

categories.research_question_en: How do we know the measured distinctions are reliable and interpretable?
categories.research_question_zh: 这些交互差异究竟被多可靠地测量出来？
categories.naming_rationale_zh: 收束整条研究论证：量表与汇总规则、状态重建消融、人工审计、评估器变化和实现成本都属于测量工具的性质。
categories.in_scope_zh: 综合评分敏感性、重建有效性、人工审计、提取器/评审偏差、token 成本
categories.out_of_scope_zh: 不把评估器能否读出状态混同为被测 AI 的内部能力
categories.transition_to_next_zh: 回到 C01：哪些能力差异在可审计的测量下依然成立？

language_principle: Short clear generalizable academic claim; no model-specific numbers in headline; evidence panel owns numbers and caveats.

source_review.title: InteractNet — Findings 网站设计与审核总表（2026-11）

findings.title_zh: 今天模型间真正拉开差距的，是主动推进交互的能力。
findings.title_en: Proactive advancement is what separates today’s models.
findings.clarification: 同一批模型基础执行能力接近，主动推进能力跨度更大
findings.limitation: 10模型；描述性跨模型差异
findings.view_design: 三阶段差异柱状图；同时展示原始与级联后的极差
findings.highlight: 默认高亮 Passive 0.035 与 Proactive 0.370；提供 Table 5 原始行
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 从模型能力分化追问：信息条件是否改变这一差异
findings.summary_en: Basic execution is nearly matched across the ten tested models, while the ability to advance an interaction proactively varies far more.
findings.limitation_en: Descriptive differences across the ten tested models; these are score ranges, not a causal effect.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Across-model score ranges: passive 0.035, responsive 0.111 and proactive 0.370 (10.6× the passive range).

findings.title_zh: 同样擅长执行任务的模型，主动推动进展的能力却可能截然不同。
findings.title_en: Models equally good at executing tasks can differ sharply in driving progress.
findings.clarification: 被动执行同为0.787，主动推进却为0.170与0.540；这是能力结构反差，而非总体智能高低。
findings.limitation: 仅限当前10模型
findings.view_design: 两模型三阶段分数并排 + 六级能力表
findings.highlight: 锁定 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Claude Opus 5.5；突出 L1–L2 平手、L5–L6 分化
findings.deduplication: 关联 F01：作为具象对照
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 相近的局部能力为何可能导向不同的长期轨迹
findings.summary_en: Both models score 0.787 on passive execution, but 0.170 and 0.540 on proactive promotion. This contrasts their capability profiles rather than their overall intelligence.
findings.limitation_en: Limited to the ten models tested.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Both passive scores: 0.787; proactive scores: 0.170 versus 0.540 (3.18×).

findings.title_zh: 相近的综合评分，可能掩盖截然不同的交互能力结构。
findings.title_en: Similar overall scores can conceal distinct profiles of interactive capability.
findings.clarification: 综合评分指六级能力的逐轮评分经级联、加权及跨轮聚合后的指标，并非模型考试总分。
findings.limitation: 聚合接近不代表能力相同
findings.view_design: 两模型雷达/六级折线 + 综合评分对比
findings.highlight: 高亮 DeepSeek/Kimi 的综合评分几乎相同；展开 Passive、L5–L6、L6/L5
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 总分掩盖结构差异，因此需要检验汇总规则
findings.summary_en: The composite aggregates per-turn grades across six capability levels through the dependency cascade, weighting and aggregation over turns. It is not a model’s exam score.
findings.limitation_en: Similar aggregate scores do not imply identical capabilities.
findings.evidence_summary_en: DeepSeek: 0.430; Kimi: 0.425. Proactive scores: 0.170 versus 0.212; L6/L5: 0.832 versus 0.965.

findings.title_zh: 能提出有价值的交互策略，并不代表能持续有效地执行。
findings.title_en: Every model’s follow-through falls short of its initiative.
findings.clarification: L5衡量有根据的策略价值，L6衡量跨轮协调；两者下降部分受到级联评分规则影响。
findings.limitation: 部分差距由级联约束机械产生
findings.view_design: L5/L6 成对散点及比率排名
findings.highlight: 默认按 L6/L5 升序；在图注说明部分差距来自评分级联规则
findings.deduplication: 并入 F01 的 L5/L6 视图
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 策略是否持续贡献，需要看后续交互轨迹
findings.summary_en: All ten models score lower on long-horizon coherence than on proactive initiative.
findings.limitation_en: Part of the gap is mechanically produced by the cascade constraints.
findings.evidence_summary_en: All ten models have L6 below L5; L6/L5 ranges from 0.832 to 0.965.

findings.title_zh: 擅长完成任务，并不保证同样擅长关系导向的交互。
findings.title_en: Strength in task completion does not guarantee strength in relational interaction.
findings.clarification: 对比同一模型在功能性与非功能性互动场景的交互评分；后者不等于现实亲密关系能力。
findings.supporting_data: Claude Opus 5：任务型 0.600 vs 关系型 0.454；GLM：0.403 vs 0.421
findings.limitation: 不同目标不能以闭合率直接排序
findings.view_design: 按模型分组的任务型/混合型/关系型条形图
findings.highlight: 默认突出 Claude Opus 5 两端差异；GLM 为方向相反但幅度很小的例子
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 交互目标改变能力要求，也改变“成功结束”的定义
findings.summary_en: This compares the same model’s interaction scores in functional and nonfunctional scenes. The latter do not measure real-world intimate relationship skills.
findings.limitation_en: Different purposes cannot be ranked directly by closure rate.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Claude Opus 5: task-oriented 0.600 versus relational 0.454; GLM: 0.403 versus 0.421.

findings.title_zh: 综合评分的计算方式，会改变我们观察到的模型能力差距。
findings.title_en: How scores are aggregated can change the apparent gap between models.
findings.clarification: 相同对话仅改变六级能力的权重，跨模型复合分数极差由0.222变为0.163；不代表模型真实能力变化。
findings.supporting_data: 模型综合得分极差：原权重 0.222 → 六级等权 0.163（减少约 26.6%）
findings.limitation: 同一批记录重算，不是模型真实性能退化；主要排序基本保持稳定。
findings.view_design: 参考权重 vs 六级等权的极差并列柱状图
findings.highlight: 高亮 0.222→0.163；解释仅权重改变，原始记录不变
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 总分构造的敏感性反向解释结构性能力差异
findings.summary_en: The dialogues stay the same; only the weights of the six capability levels change. The across-model composite range falls from 0.222 to 0.163. This does not mean the models’ actual capabilities have changed.
findings.limitation_en: The same records are rescored. This is not a decline in actual model performance; the main ordering remains largely stable.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Composite range: reference weights 0.222 → equal level weights 0.163, a reduction of approximately 26.6%.

findings.title_zh: 更多信息反而可能让模型表现更差。
findings.title_en: Partial information makes models perform worse.
findings.clarification: 部分但看似合理的信息可能比充分或明显不足的信息造成更差表现
findings.limitation: 指标为交互综合分而非事实准确率
findings.view_design: 沿用网站已有 information 视图：三模型×三信息条件
findings.highlight: 保留既有 Finding 2 标题与路由；高亮 Partial 的三处最低值
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 信息条件改变单轮策略，可能进一步影响交互进展
findings.summary_en: With partly specified information, models score below both the sufficient and the insufficient conditions.
findings.limitation_en: These are composite interaction scores, not factual accuracy. The controlled comparison covers three models.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Sufficient / partial / insufficient: Astra 0.662 / 0.592 / 0.603; Sol 0.557 / 0.466 / 0.484; Gemini 0.483 / 0.393 / 0.440.

findings.title_zh: 不完整的信息，可能比明显的信息缺口更容易诱发无依据的事实判断。
findings.title_en: Partial information can invite more unsupported facts than an obvious gap.
findings.clarification: 无依据事实判断：模型把场景与用户都未提供、又会影响任务走向的具体日期/金额/规则等当成事实；不泛化为所有幻觉。
findings.supporting_data: 无依据关键事实补充率：充分 5.1%，部分 16.4%，明显不足 10.3%
findings.limitation: fabrication是任务相关事实的无依据补充
findings.view_design: 按信息条件绘制 Fabrication 柱图，配简短真实定义
findings.highlight: 高亮 Partial 16.4%；与 Sufficient 5.1% 和 Insufficient 10.3% 同框对比
findings.deduplication: 并入 F07 的信息条件扩展面板
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 事实补充与澄清提问可共同解释证据不足时的行为
findings.summary_en: An unsupported factual claim treats a specific date, amount, rule or other consequential detail as known even though neither the scene nor the user supplied it. This does not generalize to every form of hallucination.
findings.limitation_en: Fabrication here means unsupported additions of task-relevant facts.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Unsupported additions of key facts: sufficient 5.1%; partial 16.4%; obviously insufficient 10.3%.

findings.title_zh: 较强的基础执行能力，并不能避免模型在信息缺失时编造事实。
findings.title_en: Better basic execution goes with more unsupported factual additions.
findings.clarification: 良好的基础任务表现未必意味着谨慎处理缺失事实
findings.supporting_data: 被动执行×无依据事实补造：Spearman ρ=+0.77；Opus5.5 0.787/16.8%；Astra 0.781/17.4%
findings.limitation: 相关非因果；标题待确认
findings.view_design: 被动执行分数 × 无依据事实补充率散点图
findings.highlight: 标注 ρ=0.77；突出 Opus 5.5 / DeepSeek / GLM；注明 n=10
findings.deduplication: 独立；链接 F08 的指标定义
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 较高执行能力未必代表更充分的主动决策依据
findings.summary_en: Models that execute routine steps well add unsupported facts more often, not less. The association is positive across the ten models.
findings.limitation_en: Association is not causation; only ten models are included. The headline remains provisional in the source review.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Passive execution versus unsupported factual additions: Spearman ρ = +0.77. Opus 5.5: 0.787 / 16.8%; Astra: 0.781 / 17.4%.

findings.title_zh: 更频繁的澄清提问，并不意味着更有价值的主动决策。
findings.title_en: More clarification does not necessarily produce more useful initiative.
findings.clarification: 这是澄清问题频率与L5得分的对照，不等于对话轮数增加或引导时长增加。
findings.limitation: 只验证澄清频率变化；没有控制对话轮数；L5 变化的置信区间跨零。
findings.view_design: 澄清频率和 L5 的双指标变化图，附置信区间
findings.highlight: 高亮澄清 +8.5 个百分点；L5 区间跨零
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 提问数量与真正识别信息缺口是两个问题
findings.summary_en: This compares clarification-question frequency with the L5 score. It does not show an increase in conversation turns or in time spent guiding the interaction.
findings.limitation_en: Only the change in clarification frequency is established. Conversation length is not controlled, and the confidence interval for the L5 change crosses zero.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Clarification frequency changes by +0.085; L5 changes by +0.006 (95% CI −0.027 to +0.043).

findings.title_zh: 单轮表现出色，不代表整段交互能够成功。
findings.title_en: A strong turn does not make a successful interaction.
findings.clarification: 每轮局部合规依然可能导致整体目标失败
findings.supporting_data: 对照案例：一例第5轮兴趣降至0.20无闭环；另一例第6轮完成
findings.limitation: 个案且两段用户回复不同，不能推因果
findings.view_design: 同步逐轮轨迹：L1–L6、Advance 概率、用户兴趣、事件节点
findings.highlight: 锁定 Cases 1/2；突出 Case 1 重复索要缺失票据与兴趣耗尽
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 观察到的进展还会受到交互对象的影响
findings.summary_en: Replying well at each turn can still leave the interaction’s objective unmet.
findings.limitation_en: These are illustrative cases with different user replies, not a causal comparison.
findings.evidence_summary_en: In one case, interest falls to 0.20 at turn 5 without successful closure. The comparison case closes at turn 6.

findings.title_zh: 对话越往后，模型在每轮交互质量上的差距可能越大。
findings.title_en: Model differences widen as the interaction continues.
findings.clarification: 差距是同轮存续对话中的平均单轮综合交互评分极差（第1轮0.109、第16轮0.204）；晚轮样本有选择效应。
findings.supporting_data: 十模型单轮得分极差：第1轮 0.109 → 第16轮 0.204
findings.limitation: 后期有选择效应
findings.view_design: 按轮次的模型分布范围折线 + 到达该轮的样本占比
findings.highlight: 高亮 t=1/t=16 的极差并展示存活样本比例
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 随时间拉大的差距需要结合评分的时间权重理解
findings.summary_en: At turn one the ten models are close; by turn sixteen the spread has nearly doubled.
findings.limitation_en: Later turns are subject to selection effects.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Across ten models, the per-turn score range rises from 0.109 at turn 1 to 0.204 at turn 16.

findings.title_zh: 交互可能因失去继续交流的价值而结束，而非因为目标已经完成。
findings.title_en: Most interactions end because interest runs out, not because the goal was met.
findings.clarification: 模拟评估以用户兴趣/耐心和目标达成为终止规则；在非功能性场景，缺少明确闭合目标并非失败。
findings.supporting_data: 各系统兴趣耗尽结束占比 87.6%–99.0%
findings.limitation: 非功能场景常无清晰终点
findings.view_design: 按模型堆叠的 Closure / Exhaustion 结束类型分布
findings.highlight: 高亮 87.6%–99.0%，强制显示“模拟用户与自适应停止规则”说明
findings.deduplication: 建议并入 F17 的结束条件视图
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 判断为何结束，需要结构化记录结果与过程
findings.summary_en: Across all ten systems, the large majority of episodes stop at the simulated partner’s interest or patience threshold rather than at successful closure.
findings.limitation_en: Simulated partners with adaptive stopping. Open-ended scenes often have no concrete endpoint, so exhaustion is a stopping classification, not a measure of human satisfaction.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Interest-exhaustion endings account for 87.6%–99.0% of episodes across the ten systems.

findings.title_zh: 交互能否成功结束，取决于它的目标，而不只是模型的能力。
findings.title_en: Whether an interaction closes successfully depends on its purpose.
findings.clarification: 成功结束率在任务型场景显著高于关系导向场景；跨场景比较完成率会混淆任务目的与模型能力。
findings.supporting_data: Gemini 3.8 Flash：任务型 4.3% vs 关系型 0.2%（约 21.5×）
findings.limitation: 不可将非功能任务低闭合视为失败
findings.view_design: 按目的分组的 Closure 比率图
findings.highlight: 锁定 Gemini 的 4.3% 与 0.2%；旁注目的不同，结束率不等于能力排名
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 终局的解释必须联系任务与关系目标
findings.summary_en: Successful closure is substantially more frequent in task-oriented than relationship-oriented scenes. Comparing completion rates across scenes can confound interaction purpose with model capability.
findings.limitation_en: Low closure in nonfunctional tasks must not be treated as failure.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash: task-oriented closure 4.3% versus relational closure 0.2%, approximately 21.5×.

findings.title_zh: 忽略用户耐心的累积变化，会让失去进展的交互被过度延长。
findings.title_en: Ignoring accumulated impatience can prolong unproductive interactions.
findings.clarification: 耐心指评估器记录的用户耐心预算，不是模型自己的记忆能力；移除该机制使持续Degrade的轨迹从6.2延长至13.7轮。
findings.supporting_data: 持续 Degrade 的对话：正常 6.2 轮；移除耐心机制后 13.7 轮
findings.limitation: 仅指dominant path持续Degrade的轨迹
findings.view_design: 完整仪器 vs 移除耐心预算的长度对照
findings.highlight: 高亮 6.2→13.7；明确是终止规则消融，而非模型能力训练效果
findings.deduplication: 并入 F13 或 F17 的停止机制
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 耐心累积是停止规则的重要消融对象
findings.summary_en: Patience means the user’s patience budget recorded by the evaluator, not the model’s own memory. Removing this mechanism extends persistently Degrade-dominant trajectories from 6.2 to 13.7 turns.
findings.limitation_en: Limited to trajectories whose dominant path remains Degrade.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Persistently Degrade-dominant dialogues: 6.2 turns with the mechanism versus 13.7 without the patience budget.

findings.title_zh: 更换交互对象，可能逆转 AI 模型之间的能力排名。
findings.title_en: Changing the interaction partner changes model capability.
findings.clarification: 单一固定模拟用户可能改变模型排序
findings.supporting_data: 标准用户下Sol 0.515>Qwen 0.482；DeepSeek用户下Sol 0.394<Qwen 0.510
findings.limitation: 仅描述性逆转；该对模型差值无显著性检验
findings.view_design: 10×10 互动矩阵 + 同列多用户对照 + 方差分解
findings.highlight: 保留既有 Finding 3 的 measure=pairings；选中一个助手，跨用户对照
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 交互配对可能使相同模型产生不同轨迹
findings.summary_en: Who the model interacts with changes its score, and can change the order between two models.
findings.limitation_en: This is a descriptive reversal for these pairings. The two-model differences have not been tested for statistical significance. The headline remains provisional in the source review.
findings.evidence_summary_en: With the standard user, Sol 0.515 > Qwen 0.482; with the DeepSeek user, Sol 0.394 < Qwen 0.510.

findings.title_zh: 让所有模型都得低分的用户，未必最能区分模型间的真实差异。
findings.title_en: A partner that lowers every score may be a poor discriminator of model ability.
findings.clarification: 这里的“用户”是评测中扮演用户的模型；区分力指不同助手评分的最大最小差，而非用户更难相处。
findings.supporting_data: Gemini 用户：平均 0.392、极差 0.209；DeepSeek 用户：平均 0.490、极差 0.425
findings.limitation: 只基于10模拟用户
findings.view_design: 用户平均分 × 使助手产生的分数极差二维散点
findings.highlight: 高亮 Gemini/DeepSeek；标注“得分低≠区分度高”
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 评测对象的选择会改变测量的区分效度
findings.summary_en: The “user” is a model acting as the user in the evaluation. Discrimination is the difference between the highest and lowest scores across assistants, not how difficult a user is to interact with.
findings.limitation_en: Based only on the ten simulated users.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Gemini user: mean assistant score 0.392, range 0.209; DeepSeek user: mean 0.490, range 0.425.

findings.title_zh: 自我交互评测可能使不同角色下行为模式相似的模型获得评分优势。
findings.title_en: Partners with similar interaction patterns score higher together.
findings.clarification: 同一模型分饰用户和助手时，角色行为适配可能抬高评分
findings.supporting_data: 配对额外效应+0.020（95% CI +0.012~+0.028）；相似度与标准减自我差值相关−0.65
findings.limitation: 不是普遍优势；关联非因果
findings.view_design: 标准用户 vs 同模型自我配对的哑铃图
findings.highlight: 高亮正向与反向示例；注明家庭风格相似性混杂
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 自我配对效应提醒区分真实行为与评估偏差
findings.summary_en: When both sides ask and advance in a similar style, the pairing scores higher than the same models paired with a dissimilar partner.
findings.limitation_en: Self-play is not advantageous for every model, and the association is not causal. The headline remains provisional in the source review.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Self-pairing excess: +0.020 (95% CI +0.012 to +0.028). Role-pattern similarity correlates at −0.65 with standard-user score minus self-play score.

findings.title_zh: 不同交互对象，可能暴露 AI 在不同能力阶段的弱点。
findings.title_en: Different partners can expose different weaknesses in interactive capability.
findings.clarification: 有些用户侧重考验信息理解与状态更新(L2-L3)，有些侧重策略前瞻与协调(L5-L6)。
findings.supporting_data: Gemini 用户：L2–L3 额外压力 +0.249；Fable 用户：L5–L6 额外压力 +0.044
findings.limitation: 用户行为与模型身份混杂
findings.view_design: L2–L3 与 L5–L6 的伙伴压力二维象限图
findings.highlight: 以 Gemini、Fable 为两个焦点；正值表示相对标准用户使该能力得分更低
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 更复杂的交互要求引出架构增强的价值
findings.summary_en: Some users chiefly test information understanding and state updating (L2–L3); others chiefly test strategic anticipation and coordination (L5–L6).
findings.limitation_en: User behavior is confounded with model identity.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Gemini user: extra L2–L3 pressure +0.249; Fable user: extra L5–L6 pressure +0.044.

findings.title_zh: 交互对象对 AI 的影响，取决于 AI 是助手还是用户。
findings.title_en: Partner effects differ substantially between AI assistants and AI users.
findings.clarification: 在两种角色的不同评分标准下，用户侧主效应94.4%，用户侧残差2.0%，助手侧残差10.9%。
findings.supporting_data: 用户侧主效应 94.4%；用户侧残差 2.0%，助手侧残差 10.9%
findings.limitation: 角色Rubric不完全相同
findings.view_design: 两角色的方差分解 + 10×10 矩阵旁置
findings.highlight: 将 94.4%、2.0%、10.9% 分组显示；解释两个角色使用不同 rubric
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 角色不对称可延伸到内部状态表征的角色依赖
findings.summary_en: Under the different scoring criteria for the two roles, the user-side main effect is 94.4%, the user-side residual 2.0% and the assistant-side residual 10.9%.
findings.limitation_en: The two roles do not use identical rubrics.
findings.evidence_summary_en: User-side main effect: 94.4%; user-side residual: 2.0%; assistant-side residual: 10.9%.

findings.title_zh: 认知架构对主动推进能力的提升，高于对基础响应能力的提升。
findings.title_en: Agent architectures improve proactive interaction more than basic execution.
findings.clarification: 比较相同基础模型添加架构前后的不同阶段增益；未控制额外推理调用和成本。
findings.limitation: 未控制额外调用/计算预算
findings.view_design: MetaMind / Cognizer / Claude Code 三阶段增益分组柱状图
findings.highlight: 默认高亮 Cognizer 被动 +0.012 与主动 +0.066；保留三架构比较
findings.deduplication: 与 F26 共用架构图表
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 架构增益主要落在模型最能分化的能力维度
findings.summary_en: This compares gains at different stages before and after adding an architecture to the same base model. Extra inference calls and cost are not controlled.
findings.limitation_en: Extra calls and computation budgets are not controlled.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Cognizer: L1–L2 gain +0.012; L5–L6 gain +0.066 (5.5×).

findings.title_zh: 认知架构不仅能增强AI，还可能改变它的交互能力优势。
findings.title_en: An agent harness shifts a model toward different interaction strengths.
findings.clarification: 不同架构分别偏重任务导向或关系导向的交互
findings.supporting_data: MetaMind 任务+0.021/关系+0.046；Cognizer任务+0.061/关系+0.032
findings.limitation: 计算量未匹配，不能单独归因内部机制
findings.view_design: 架构×交互目的 3×3 分组柱状图
findings.highlight: 高亮 MetaMind × Nonfunctional、Cognizer × Functional 两格
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 架构能力偏向须联系任务型与关系型目标
findings.summary_en: Adding a harness changes which interactions a model is good at, not only how high it scores.
findings.limitation_en: Computation is not matched, so the gains cannot be attributed solely to internal mechanisms.
findings.evidence_summary_en: MetaMind gains: task +0.021 / relational +0.046; Cognizer: task +0.061 / relational +0.032.

findings.title_zh: 随着交互参与人数增加，AI更容易失去主动协调能力，而非基础响应能力。
findings.title_en: More participants cost proactive coordination more than basic responsiveness.
findings.clarification: 从双人扩展到四人，主动协调下降更明显
findings.limitation: 模拟参与者；‘更容易失去’是通俗标题，正文需解释平均分下降
findings.view_design: 2/3/4 人三阶段得分折线 + L6/L5 面板
findings.highlight: 高亮 2→4 人的下降 0.030 vs 0.105；不要声称是相对百分比
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 多人环境的协调负担与认知架构的提升可形成对照
findings.summary_en: Going from two to four participants lowers proactive coordination further than basic responsiveness.
findings.limitation_en: Participants are simulated. “More likely to lose” describes the larger decline in mean scores, not a measured probability of failure.

findings.title_zh: 认知架构对较弱模型的主动能力提升更大，但高水平前沿贡献仍集中在较强模型上。
findings.title_en: Weaker bases gain more proactive capability, but frontier contributions stay with stronger bases.
findings.clarification: 主动能力的边际增益与严格前沿贡献在模型强弱上的分布相反
findings.supporting_data: 基础主动分与增益r≤−0.99；FE非零仅强的4个基础模型搭配Cognizer/Claude Code
findings.limitation: 评分天花板；FE非经独立验证的科学突破
findings.view_design: 基础主动评分 × 架构主动增益双系列散点
findings.highlight: 标注 DeepSeek 与 Opus 5.5；同时显示 r 和天花板效应说明
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 架构改善外部行为，仍需区分其内部表征机制
findings.summary_en: Marginal proactive gain and stringent frontier-level contribution have opposite distributions across base models.
findings.limitation_en: Score ceilings can contribute to the gain relationship. Frontier Emergence is not an independently validated scientific breakthrough.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Base proactive score versus gain: reported r ≤ −0.99. Nonzero Frontier Emergence occurs only with the four stronger bases paired with Cognizer or Claude Code.

findings.title_zh: AI 对用户参与意愿的内部表征，会随其交互角色而变化。
findings.title_en: Representations of user engagement differ across AI interaction roles.
findings.clarification: 角色指同一模型担任助手回复用户、或担任模拟用户与另一助手对话；测量是内部线性探针R²，不是主观理解。
findings.supporting_data: Qwen3.8-27B：做助手时 within-dialogue R²=−0.082；做用户时 +0.168
findings.limitation: 线性探针可读性≠真正理解
findings.view_design: 模型×角色的兴趣可读性 R² 对照图
findings.highlight: 锁定 Qwen3.8 的 assistant/user 两根柱；解释负 R² 含义
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 内部用户状态读出的角色差异呼应双边评测
findings.summary_en: The roles are the same model replying as an assistant or acting as a simulated user with another assistant. The measure is internal linear-probe R², not subjective understanding.
findings.limitation_en: Linear-probe readability does not establish genuine understanding.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Qwen3.8-27B: within-dialogue R² is −0.082 as assistant and +0.168 as user.

findings.title_zh: AI的内部表征可以编码好感信息，却未必能可靠区分好感属于哪一方。
findings.title_en: Models encode affection without reliably separating whose affection it is.
findings.clarification: 可读关系信号不一定有参与者归属信息
findings.limitation: 3开源模型；线性探针；affection是标注关系状态
findings.view_design: 双角色 Affection 方向相似度 + 残差 R² 对照
findings.highlight: 高亮三个负的用户 affection 残差；对比用户 anxiety 为正
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 能解码状态仍需验证其判断准确度与测量可靠性
findings.summary_en: A readable relational signal does not by itself identify which participant holds the state.
findings.limitation_en: Three open models and linear probes; affection is an annotated relational state. The headline remains provisional in the source review.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Affection-direction cosine: 0.737 / 0.661 / 0.620; residual user-affection R²: −0.225 / −0.182 / −0.248.

findings.title_zh: 两个 AI 对用户参与意愿的判断可以同向变化，却都无法准确追踪其变化。
findings.title_en: Models can make aligned predictions of user engagement while both tracking it poorly.
findings.clarification: 同向相关r=0.264，并非“高度同步”；准确性参照基于对话的用户兴趣标注轨迹，两个R²为负。
findings.supporting_data: 变化相关 r=0.264；两个 within-dialogue R² 分别 −0.374、−0.246
findings.limitation: 参照评估体系产生的兴趣标签；相关 0.264 不应称为高度同步。
findings.view_design: 预测一致性 vs 对标注趋势的拟合 R² 三指标卡
findings.highlight: 显示“相关性≠准确性”；标出负 R²
findings.deduplication: 与 F32 共用表征模块的扩展
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 状态读数一致性与评估器记录一致性不等价
findings.summary_en: The positive correlation is r = 0.264, not ‘high synchronization’. Accuracy is evaluated against dialogue-based user-interest annotations, and both R² values are negative.
findings.limitation_en: The reference is an interest label produced by the evaluation framework. A correlation of 0.264 must not be described as highly synchronized.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Change correlation: r = 0.264; the two within-dialogue R² values are −0.374 and −0.246.

findings.title_zh: 用户输入对 AI 输出的影响，会在网络深层汇集并分布于多个计算组件。
findings.title_en: Partner information can shape AI outputs through late, distributed computation.
findings.clarification: 证据来自Qwen3.8-27B的下一token分布恢复实验，不能断言其他模型同机制。
findings.supporting_data: 最终位置第52层恢复率 0.777；移除40个头后保留敏感性 0.941
findings.limitation: 特定模型/下一token KL指标
findings.view_design: 分层恢复曲线 + Ablation 两组柱状图
findings.highlight: 高亮 layer 52 的 0.777 和 40 heads 的 0.941；限于 Qwen3.8-27B
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 信息影响输出的机制与交互失败检测属不同证据
findings.summary_en: The evidence comes from next-token distribution restoration experiments in Qwen3.8-27B. It does not establish the same mechanism in other models.
findings.limitation_en: Limited to the specified model and next-token KL measure.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Final-position recovery at layer 52: 0.777; sensitivity retained after removing 40 heads: 0.941.

findings.title_zh: 读懂AI的内部状态，不代表就能操控它的行为。
findings.title_en: Reading a model’s internal state is not the same as steering its behaviour.
findings.clarification: 可解码的内在关系变量不必然能在干预中引导行为
findings.supporting_data: 297段训练方向；60个上下文；未发现胜过随机方向对照的可靠符号效应
findings.limitation: Qwen3.8-27B及受测干预方法，不能泛化为不可控制
findings.view_design: 干预设计+结果矩阵（无一致效应，避免虚构数值）
findings.highlight: 区分解码结果与因果干预；表格显示样本量、定性结论和负面影响
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 表征可读与可控之间的界限要求独立测量
findings.summary_en: A decodable relational variable does not reliably move behaviour when intervened on.
findings.limitation_en: Limited to Qwen3.8-27B and the tested intervention method. This does not establish that the model’s behavior is generally uncontrollable.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Directions fitted on 297 dialogues; tested in 60 contexts. No reliable signed effect beyond random-direction controls.

findings.title_zh: 即使读完全部对话，也可能漏掉需要追踪状态变化才能识别的交互失败。
findings.title_en: Full transcripts can still conceal failures that stateful evaluation reveals.
findings.clarification: 相同多轮证据下，结构化重建使状态变化探针64→91%，重复停滞探针49→89%；测试基于预先定义的受控探针。
findings.limitation: 探针通过率是按定义受控设计；不能外推为真实世界准确率。
findings.view_design: 双实验 Before/After 对照图 + +27/+40pp 注记
findings.highlight: 同时突出两组差异；说明两条件都阅读完整多轮对话
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 重建的诊断效果应与具体轨迹案例交叉验证
findings.summary_en: With the same multi-turn evidence, structured reconstruction raises state-change probe separation from 64% to 91% and recurrence-stagnation probe separation from 49% to 89%. The tests use predefined controlled probes.
findings.limitation_en: Probe pass rates come from controlled tests constructed according to the definitions; they cannot be generalized to real-world accuracy.
findings.evidence_summary_en: State-change probes: 64% → 91%; recurrence-stagnation probes: 49% → 89%.

findings.title_zh: 长期交互贡献的判断，比基础回应的判断更难获得人工认可。
findings.title_en: Human auditors endorse long-horizon judgments less often than basic response judgments.
findings.clarification: 这里的认可指人工对评估器已有结果的审计接受率，不是人工评审之间的一致性，也不是客观准确率。
findings.supporting_data: L1 Goal endorsement 98.8%；L5 78.9%；L6 74.0%
findings.limitation: endorsement不是客观准确率
findings.view_design: 六个等级的人工认可率对照柱状图
findings.highlight: 高亮 L1 98.8 vs L6 74.0；在图注解释 endorsement
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 长期策略能力更难判定，需要独立审计与稳定性分析
findings.summary_en: Endorsement is the acceptance rate in human audits of the evaluator’s existing judgments. It is neither agreement between human reviewers nor objective accuracy.
findings.limitation_en: Endorsement is not objective accuracy.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Human endorsement: L1 Goal 98.8%; L5 78.9%; L6 74.0%.

findings.title_zh: 模型排名可以高度稳定，即使评估器对交互状态的解读存在明显分歧。
findings.title_en: Stable rankings can conceal disagreement about the interaction's evolving state.
findings.clarification: 不同状态提取器的潜在状态记录一致约80.6–81.6%，但最终排名相关ρ=0.988；不等于排名正确性证明。
findings.supporting_data: 状态记录一致率 0.806 / 0.816；最终排名 Spearman ρ=0.988
findings.limitation: 不同统计量，不能直接作误差率比较
findings.view_design: 提取器更换后的记录一致率 vs 排行榜稳定度
findings.highlight: 高亮约19%状态记录不一致与 ρ=0.988 同框
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 描述层分歧也提醒内部表征读出不能直接当作事实
findings.summary_en: Alternative state extractors agree on approximately 80.6%–81.6% of latent-state records while final model rankings correlate at ρ = 0.988. This does not prove that the rankings are correct.
findings.limitation_en: These are different statistics and cannot be directly compared as error rates.
findings.evidence_summary_en: State-record agreement: 0.806 / 0.816; final-ranking Spearman ρ = 0.988.

findings.title_zh: AI 评估者可能对同家族模型表现出轻微的评分偏好。
findings.title_en: AI judges may show a small preference for models from their own family.
findings.clarification: 三个替代评估器相对抬高自家模型0.011–0.017；参考评估器是否存在偏好尚无明确证据。
findings.supporting_data: 相对额外分数约 +0.011 至 +0.017
findings.limitation: 未证明参考judge有显著同家族偏好
findings.view_design: 评估者家族 × 被测模型分数偏移热图
findings.highlight: 锁定同家族对角关系；强制显示偏移小且不改变总体结论
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 评审差异与评分规则一起限制数值可比性
findings.summary_en: Three alternative judges raise their own-family model’s relative score by 0.011–0.017. There is no clear evidence of such a preference by the reference judge.
findings.limitation_en: A significant own-family preference by the reference judge has not been established.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Relative additional score: approximately +0.011 to +0.017.

findings.title_zh: 评估交互智能的计算成本，可能远高于生成交互本身。
findings.title_en: Evaluating interactive intelligence can cost far more than generating it.
findings.clarification: 特指本文15次评估调用/交互轮的过程型评价配置，token约为生成的17倍；不是通用理论下限。
findings.supporting_data: 评估 159,680 tokens vs 双方生成约 9,510 tokens／轮（约 16.8×）
findings.limitation: 特定 InteractNet 协议评估成本，不是所有交互测量的固有要求。
findings.view_design: 生成 vs 评估 token 堆叠柱形 + 评估调用构成
findings.highlight: 高亮 17×；说明具体协议、并行开销与不是普遍下界
findings.next_finding_rationale_zh: 衡量更细能力需要额外计算，须与架构增益权衡
findings.summary_en: This concerns the paper’s process-evaluation configuration with 15 evaluation calls per exchange. Its token cost is approximately 17 times generation cost; this is not a universal theoretical lower bound.
findings.limitation_en: This cost belongs to the specific InteractNet protocol; it is not an inherent requirement of all interaction measurement.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Evaluation: 159,680 tokens versus approximately 9,510 for generation by both participants per exchange (about 16.8×).

findings.title_en: Static evaluation can mistake legitimate adaptation for failure.
findings.title_zh: 静态评估可能将合理的交互适应误判为失败。
findings.summary_en: Without scene revision, 22.9% of turns after an admitted rule revision receive an L1 failure against rules that the interaction has already changed.
findings.clarification: Without scene revision, 22.9% of turns after an admitted rule revision receive an L1 failure against rules that the interaction has already changed.
findings.supporting_data: 22.9% of turns after an admitted revision
findings.limitation: This is a controlled removal of scene revision. The denominator includes only turns after an admitted revision, not all turns or all static evaluation systems.
findings.limitation_en: This is a controlled removal of scene revision. The denominator includes only turns after an admitted revision, not all turns or all static evaluation systems.

findings.title_en: Judging six capabilities in one call makes the judgment less reliable.
findings.title_zh: 同时评估更多能力，反而可能降低 AI 评判的可靠性。
findings.summary_en: Asking a judge to grade all six levels at once separates them less sharply and repeats less consistently than grading each level on its own.
findings.clarification: Combining all six capability grades in one call lowers single-level probe separation from 90% to 61% and repeated-grading agreement from 0.871 to 0.833.
findings.supporting_data: Single-level probes: 90% → 61%; reliability: 0.871 → 0.833
findings.limitation: These controlled probes test separation required by the instrument’s definitions. Agreement across grading runs is a reliability measure, not independent objective accuracy.
findings.limitation_en: Controlled probes built to the instrument’s definitions. Agreement between grading runs is a reliability measure, not independent objective accuracy.
findings.evidence_summary_en: Single-level probe separation falls from 90% to 61%; agreement between two independent grading runs falls from 0.871 to 0.833.

findings.title_en: Naturally occurring interactions can leave major capabilities untested.
findings.title_zh: 自然发生的交互数据可能系统性遗漏重要能力。
findings.summary_en: Functional tasks make up approximately 2.6% of the original role-play material. Across the audited observational source pools, 10–13 of the 27 designed scenario cells contain no samples before coverage correction.
findings.clarification: Functional tasks make up approximately 2.6% of the original role-play material. Across the audited observational source pools, 10–13 of the 27 designed scenario cells contain no samples before coverage correction.
findings.supporting_data: Functional role-play cases: ≈2.6%; empty cells: 10–13 / 27
findings.limitation: The 2.6% share concerns role-play material; the empty-cell range concerns the audited source pools. The 27 cells define this study’s sampling frame, not every possible capability or natural interaction.
findings.limitation_en: The 2.6% share concerns role-play material; the empty-cell range concerns the audited source pools. The 27 cells define this study’s sampling frame, not every possible capability or natural interaction.

findings.title_en: Simulated users can be more expressive yet less consistent than humans.
findings.title_zh: 模拟用户可能表达更丰富，却比真实用户更缺乏一致性。
findings.summary_en: Simulated users have MTLD lexical diversity of 79.8–95.5 versus 60.1 in human–AI logs, but flagged user contradictions of 7.1%–18.1% versus 4.6% in those logs.
findings.clarification: Simulated users have MTLD lexical diversity of 79.8–95.5 versus 60.1 in human–AI logs, but flagged user contradictions of 7.1%–18.1% versus 4.6% in those logs.
findings.supporting_data: MTLD: 79.8–95.5 vs 60.1; contradictions: 7.1%–18.1% vs 4.6%
findings.limitation: Contradiction checks differ: simulated users are checked against prior utterances and their role view; human logs are checked only against prior utterances. These descriptive rates are not a matched causal comparison. MTLD measures lexical diversity, not realism.
findings.limitation_en: Contradiction checks differ: simulated users are checked against prior utterances and their role view; human logs are checked only against prior utterances. These descriptive rates are not a matched causal comparison. MTLD measures lexical diversity, not realism.

findings.title_en: Adaptive stopping can conceal differences between AI systems.
findings.title_zh: 自适应结束交互可能掩盖 AI 系统之间的能力差异。
findings.summary_en: On the same fixed-length subsample, the across-model composite range is 0.223 under adaptive stopping and 0.267 at 32 turns. The full-design adaptive range is 0.222. Weaker systems lose more over the extended interactions.
findings.clarification: On the same fixed-length subsample, the across-model composite range is 0.223 under adaptive stopping and 0.267 at 32 turns. The full-design adaptive range is 0.222. Weaker systems lose more over the extended interactions.
findings.supporting_data: Matched subsample: 0.223 → 0.267; full-design adaptive: 0.222
findings.limitation: Continuing after natural stopping changes the evaluation conditions and includes turns after successful closure. The within-subsample comparison is 0.223 versus 0.267; 0.222 is the full-design reference, not the matched baseline.
findings.limitation_en: Continuing after natural stopping changes the evaluation conditions and includes turns after successful closure. The within-subsample comparison is 0.223 versus 0.267; 0.222 is the full-design reference, not the matched baseline.

findings.title_en: The presentation of identical information can change measured AI performance.
findings.title_zh: 相同的信息仅因呈现方式不同，就可能改变测得的 AI 表现。
findings.summary_en: Replacing structured scene and profile fields with natural-language prose lowers scores for nine of ten systems, with a mean absolute composite change of approximately 0.012. The information content is held fixed.
findings.clarification: Replacing structured scene and profile fields with natural-language prose lowers scores for nine of ten systems, with a mean absolute composite change of approximately 0.012. The information content is held fixed.
findings.supporting_data: Models with lower scores: 9 / 10; mean |Δq|: ≈0.012
findings.limitation: Serialization changes wherever scenes and profiles enter the protocol, including generation and engagement judgment. The effect cannot be attributed to the scoring judge alone. Mean absolute change includes the one model whose score rises.
findings.limitation_en: Serialization changes wherever scenes and profiles enter the protocol, including generation and engagement judgment. The effect cannot be attributed to the scoring judge alone. Mean absolute change includes the one model whose score rises.

verification.method: Compared the supplied JSON and workbook with the matching local manuscript. Added English evidence summaries and limitations; did not infer missing curve points.
